# TestScript for 15-cascading-searchpaths
# Asserts cascading config file search paths and tiered merging (system -> user -> local)

env HOME=$WORK/home
env SYSCONF_DIR=$WORK/etc/cascading-searchpaths

# 1. Cascading merge of system -> user -> local
exec cascading-searchpaths
stdout '⚙  cascading-searchpaths'
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+.*etc[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml, .*cascading-searchpaths\.yaml, cascading-searchpaths\.yaml\s+● config '
stdout '--api-endpoint\s+string\s+https://api\.local\.dev\s+● config cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+15s\s+● config .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--theme\s+string\s+light\s+● config .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--telemetry\s+bool\s+false\s+● config .*etc[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'

# 2. --why attributes each winning value to its tier and lists every loaded
#    cascade file
exec cascading-searchpaths --why
stdout '--api-endpoint\s+https://api\.local\.dev\s+config \(cascading-searchpaths\.yaml\)'
stdout '--timeout\s+15s\s+config \(.*home[/\\]\.\.\.[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml\)'
stdout '--theme\s+light\s+config \(.*home[/\\]\.\.\.[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml\)'
stdout '--telemetry\s+false\s+config \(.*etc[/\\]\.\.\.[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml\)'
stdout '\.\s+loaded: cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '.*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\s+loaded: .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '.*etc[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\s+loaded: .*etc[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
! stdout '██████'

# 3. CLI flag overrides cascading merged values
exec cascading-searchpaths --theme solarized --timeout 5s
stdout '--theme\s+string\s+solarized\s+● cli --theme'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+5s\s+● cli --timeout'

# 4. Explicit -c disables cascading: only that single file is loaded
exec cascading-searchpaths -c home/.config/cascading-searchpaths/cascading-searchpaths.yaml
stdout '--theme\s+string\s+light\s+● config home[/\\]\.config[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+15s\s+● config home[/\\]\.config[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--api-endpoint\s+string\s+https://api\.default\.io\s+· default'
stdout '--telemetry\s+bool\s+true\s+· default'

# 5. Missing explicit config file fails with a clean error (exit 1)
exit-status 1 cascading-searchpaths -c missing.yaml
stderr 'cannot read config file "missing\.yaml"'

# 6. Partial cascade: missing intermediate files are skipped silently
rm home/.config/cascading-searchpaths/cascading-searchpaths.yaml
exec cascading-searchpaths
stdout '--api-endpoint\s+string\s+https://api\.local\.dev\s+● config cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+30s\s+● config .*etc[/\\]cascading-searchpaths[/\\]cascading-searchpaths\.yaml'
stdout '--theme\s+string\s+dark\s+· default'

-- etc/cascading-searchpaths/cascading-searchpaths.yaml --
api-endpoint: "https://api.system.corp"
timeout: "30s"
telemetry: false

-- home/.config/cascading-searchpaths/cascading-searchpaths.yaml --
theme: "light"
timeout: "15s"

-- cascading-searchpaths.yaml --
api-endpoint: "https://api.local.dev"
